name: University of Wollongong
summary: Wollongong university south of Sydney with more than 200 undergraduate degrees; sessions start in autumn and spring.

ib.text: Entry is on a minimum IB score listed for each degree in UOW's course finder, plus any audition or interview. Meeting the score does not always guarantee a place; relevant IB subjects can earn adjustment points.

apply.via: UOW Apply (direct) or an approved UOW agent

notes: UOW encourages international students to apply with an approved UOW agent, and some can apply directly through UOW Apply; UAC is for Australian and New Zealand citizens and permanent residents.
Each degree's entry requirements and per-degree IB score are in UOW's course finder; no international closing date is published, so apply early.
UOW also teaches at campuses abroad, including Dubai, Malaysia, Singapore and Hong Kong.

sources.title: UOW: How to apply, international students
